subject.title: fix: surface non-deliverable terminal turn as outbound error payload to channel plugins

question: Should OpenClaw solve non_deliverable_terminal_turn for SDK/message_tool_only channels with an automatic core fallback that bypasses source suppression for this terminal state, or require plugin-owned terminal-failure handling?
rationale: Both viable directions change user-visible channel delivery semantics, and the linked canonical issue is already marked as needing maintainer/product direction before this contract changes.

options.title: Approve a narrow core fallback
options.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback only for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, with direct and follow-up delivery tests plus real channel proof before merge.

options.title: Use a plugin SDK hook
options.body: OpenClaw exposes a documented terminal-failure hook and requires channel plugins to opt in to visible fallback delivery.

options.title: Keep message-tool-only strict
options.body: OpenClaw leaves automatic source delivery suppressed and closes or pauses core fallback PRs until a different channel-owned path is chosen.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core fallback
recommendation.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback only for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, with direct and follow-up delivery tests plus real channel proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current blame and PR metadata tie this account to both the terminal classifier and the message_tool_only delivery gates under review.
